name: manual_f0154c
claim: For multi-harness development with Everything Claude Code (ECC) and Antigravity/Gemini: the local runtime overlay in scripts/git/ecc-local-overlay.tsv must remain harmonized across .antigravity/*, .gemini/*, .claude/*, and .env.example, and be verified via check_local_runtime_overlay.py and ecc-submodule-sync.sh restore whenever submodule pointers update.

decisions.notes: Multi-harness ECC synchronization ensures unified agent rules, shared MCPs, and zero working tree drift across Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex without losing local-only additions.

rationale: Multi-harness ECC synchronization ensures unified agent rules, shared MCPs, and zero working tree drift across Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex without losing local-only additions.
